about_the_game:
This is a charming and challenging puzzle platformer starring a determined little penguin on a heartfelt quest to reunite with his true love. Journey through a variety of cleverly designed levels, each filled with tricky obstacles and puzzling mechanics that require both timing and strategy.

Your mission is simple: reach the pink penguin, the love of your life. But there's a catch—you must first touch the white cooling block before approaching her. If you don’t cool down first, your passionate energy will be too much, and the reunion will fail! Every level tests your ability to plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and master your timing.

You’ll earn points for every level you successfully complete, and the faster you finish, the higher your score. But be careful—if you choose to retry a level, you'll lose points, so perfection pays off. Can you guide the penguin through every stage, solve all the puzzles, and reunite the lovebirds in record time?

Controls:

WSAD or ARROW keys to move
